beats.text: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
A person, maybe 60s heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
🪤 A person, maybe 60s is back. "Snares were empty. They'll keep."
🪤 A person, maybe 60s is back from the pit line. "Pit was quiet. They'll keep."
Recipe: Snare (Level 1). You have seen a snare. A loop, a stick, an animal.

🪤 A person, maybe 60s catches you watching the snares come off the line. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They show you — the loop, the trigger stick, where the run narrows between the roots. "Opossum trails. Check at dawn. Always." Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Recipe: Pit Trap (Level 1). A pit with stakes in the bottom. Dig it on a trail, brush it over, wait.

🪤 A person, maybe 60s catches you watching the pit line. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They walk you out to it — the depth, the sharpened stakes at the bottom, where the game trail runs. "Brush it over with leaves. And mark it well — your own pit will take you too." Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.

You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on).
